site_schema.summary: The structured data presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner and advertises generative AI development services, which conflict with the approved staffing and recruiting position. It also includes unsupported service promises, timelines, founder claims, and liability coverage details.

llm_problems.title: Applied AI company positioning
llm_problems.issue: The structured data positions GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner rather than the approved staffing and recruiting agency.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the Applied AI Engineering positioning with the approved company description and current service positioning.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: Applied AI Engineering Partner
locations.reason: This label describes GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner, not as a staffing and recruiting agency.

locations.quote: GoGloby is an Applied AI Engineering partner turning engineering into AI-native production
locations.reason: This description repeats the Applied AI Engineering positioning instead of the approved company description.

locations.quote: We are a US-based talent acquisition agency specializing in assisting tech companies to discover, assess, and hire the world's most thoroughly vetted talent within the US & EU time zones.
locations.reason: This describes a broad talent acquisition agency serving US and EU time zones rather than the approved Data & AI Engineers staffing and recruiting agency.

llm_problems.title: Former engineering delivery offer
llm_problems.issue: The catalog offers Applied AI Engineering delivery and positions GoGloby as putting AI systems into production, rather than selling its current staffing and recruiting services.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the Applied AI Engineering delivery offer and describe only the current recruiting and staffing services.
llm_problems.subject: Applied AI Engineering
llm_problems.source_value: US Data & AI Engineers Recruiting; Nearshore Data & AI Engineers Staffing

locations.quote: GoGloby turns engineering into AI-native production.
locations.reason: This promises an engineering transformation offer that the company documents exclude.

locations.quote: It puts Claude into production for established software, without risking the codebase.
locations.reason: This presents AI implementation and production delivery as a GoGloby offer.

locations.quote: Forward-deployed AI Solutions Architects, safe by design.
locations.reason: This markets AI Solutions Architects as a delivery offer rather than roles GoGloby recruits and staffs.

llm_problems.title: Generative AI development services
llm_problems.issue: The structured data sells generative AI development and ongoing delivery services that are not among GoGloby's current offers.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the generative AI development service and retain only the documented recruiting and staffing services.
llm_problems.subject: Generative AI Development Services
llm_problems.source_value: US Data & AI Engineers Recruiting; Nearshore Data & AI Engineers Staffing

locations.quote: Generative AI Development Services
locations.reason: This names a development service that GoGloby no longer offers.

locations.quote: Production-ready generative AI delivery covering GenAI integration, multi-agent orchestration, optimization and evaluation, and ongoing support and governance.
locations.reason: This describes GoGloby delivering and supporting generative AI systems rather than staffing or recruiting engineers.

locations.quote: build copilots, AI agents, RAG applications, and agentic workflows
locations.reason: This promises software development deliverables that are outside the documented services.

llm_problems.title: Unsupported AI delivery timelines
llm_problems.issue: The page makes AI delivery and feature timelines that are not documented for GoGloby's services.
llm_problems.fix: Remove these delivery promises or replace them with verified timelines for the current services.
llm_problems.subject: Service timelines
llm_problems.source_value: 2–3 weeks to start for staffing; 4–6 weeks to offer for recruiting

locations.quote: Forward-deployed into your team in under 4 weeks.
locations.reason: This gives a timeline for deploying a delivery team that is not stated in the service facts.

locations.quote: First validated feature in 3 to 5 business days.
locations.reason: This promises a feature delivery milestone that is not documented for staffing.

llm_problems.title: Zero IP exposure guarantee
llm_problems.issue: The page guarantees zero IP exposure, while the source documents state client IP ownership and describe security controls without making this guarantee.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the zero-exposure guarantee and use only the documented IP and security terms.
llm_problems.subject: IP exposure
llm_problems.source_value: Client owns all IP; engineers work inside the client's secure development environment

locations.quote: Zero IP exposure.
locations.reason: This makes an absolute IP-exposure guarantee not present in the company documents.

llm_problems.title: Unverified profile delivery promise
llm_problems.issue: The page promises vetted profiles within 72 hours, a turnaround time absent from the service facts.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the 72-hour profile delivery claim unless it is verified and approved.
llm_problems.subject: Profile delivery time

locations.quote: Vetted profiles delivered in 72 hours.
locations.reason: This promises a profile delivery deadline that the service facts do not provide.

llm_problems.title: Staffing replacement guarantee differs
llm_problems.issue: The page promises a 120-day telemetry-backed replacement guarantee for staffing, while the documented staffing replacement is performance-based and the client may cancel during the first 120 days.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the staffing guarantee with the documented performance-based replacement and cancellation terms.
llm_problems.subject: Nearshore staffing guarantee
llm_problems.source_value: Performance-based replacement at no cost if results fall below baseline; cancel any time in the first 120 days

locations.quote: 120-day telemetry-backed replacement guarantee.
locations.reason: This describes a blanket 120-day replacement guarantee rather than the documented performance-based replacement terms.

llm_problems.title: Liability coverage differs
llm_problems.rule: Fact Sheet: Services; Legal and security
llm_problems.issue: The page describes $3M combined liability including professional liability, while the Fact Sheet specifies a $3M data and cyber-liability policy.
llm_problems.fix: Use the documented $3M data and cyber-liability coverage description.
llm_problems.subject: Insurance coverage

locations.quote: $3M combined liability (cyber, data and professional) from day one.
locations.reason: This includes professional liability in the coverage claim, unlike the documented policy.

locations.quote: $3M combined liability (cyber, data and professional) included.
locations.reason: This again claims professional liability as part of the $3M coverage.

llm_problems.title: Unverified recruiting shortlist time
llm_problems.issue: The page promises a recruiting shortlist in five days, while the documented recruiting timeline is four to six weeks to offer.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the five-day shortlist promise or verify and approve it as a separate service commitment.
llm_problems.subject: Recruiting shortlist time

locations.quote: Shortlist delivered in 5 days.
locations.reason: This promises a shortlist deadline not specified in the recruiting service facts.

llm_problems.title: Unverified faster hiring claim
llm_problems.issue: The page claims recruiting is 50 percent faster than US job boards, a comparison not supported by the company documents.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the comparative hiring-speed claim unless it is substantiated and approved.
llm_problems.subject: Recruiting speed
llm_problems.page_value: 50 percent faster than US job boards

locations.quote: 50 percent faster time-to-hire than US job boards.
locations.reason: This makes a comparative performance claim that the Fact Sheet does not substantiate.

llm_problems.title: Unverified network geography
llm_problems.issue: The page claims a recruiting network across more than five US-time-zone countries, which is not stated in the company documents.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the country-count claim unless it is verified and approved.
llm_problems.subject: Recruiting network

locations.quote: Talent network spans 5 plus US-timezone countries.
locations.reason: This gives a network size and geographic reach not contained in the company facts.

llm_problems.title: Unverified founder experience claims
llm_problems.issue: The page attributes a decade of work across named countries and $60M-plus in generated value to Vit Koval, claims absent from the founder facts.
llm_problems.fix: Remove or verify the founder experience and value claims against approved company information.
llm_problems.subject: Vit Koval

locations.quote: For the past decade, has helped engineering leaders scale teams across the US, Canada, Argentina, Brazil, Mexico, and Europe
locations.reason: This founder biography claims a decade of work across these countries, which is not in the approved founder biography.

locations.quote: generating $60M+ in value.
locations.reason: This attributes a quantified value-generation result to the founder that the sources do not report.

llm_problems.title: Unverified founder system claim
llm_problems.issue: The page says Vit Koval built the Applied AI Engineering system, a claim not contained in his approved founder biography.
llm_problems.fix: Remove or verify this attribution using approved founder information.
llm_problems.subject: Vit Koval
llm_problems.page_value: Built the Applied AI Engineering system

locations.quote: Built the Applied AI Engineering system
locations.reason: This attributes creation of the system to Vit Koval, which the founder facts do not state.

llm_problems.title: Unverified Sergey role claims
llm_problems.issue: The page assigns Sergey specific methodology, environment-design, and Applied AI system responsibilities not stated in his approved title or founder biography.
llm_problems.fix: Use only verified founder responsibilities and remove unsupported system claims.
llm_problems.subject: Sergey Matikaynen
llm_problems.page_value: Leads Agentic SDLC methodology and secure development environment design
llm_problems.source_value: Co-Founder and CTO; leads infrastructure behind AI-native engineering

locations.quote: Leads the Agentic SDLC methodology, secure development environment design, and the technical architecture behind the Applied AI Engineering system.
locations.reason: This assigns specific responsibilities and an Applied AI system architecture role not stated in the approved founder information.

llm_problems.issue: The page calls GoGloby's talent the world's most thoroughly vetted without evidence for that comparative claim.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the unsupported superlative and use only the documented assessment facts.
llm_problems.subject: Candidate vetting

locations.quote: the world's most thoroughly vetted talent
locations.reason: This makes a global superlative claim that is not supported by the assessment facts.

llm_problems.issue: The page claims GoGloby makes every feature ship faster, a result not stated in the company documents.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the universal speed claim unless it is supported and approved.

locations.quote: every feature shipped faster.
